## Data Requirements

We need voter registration party data for this state with the following requirements:

### Geographic Granularity (in order of preference):
- [ ] Census tract level (ideal)
- [ ] Precinct level (preferred)
- [ ] Census block level
- [ ] County level (acceptable as fallback)

### Data Fields Required:
- Total registered voters
- Democratic registered voters
- Republican registered voters
- Other/Independent registered voters (or breakdown by minor parties)
- Date of data snapshot
- Geographic identifier (FIPS code, GEOID, or spatial boundary)

### Format Preferences:
- [ ] CSV
- [ ] Excel
- [ ] API access
- [ ] Other (specify): _______________

### Cost:
- [ ] Free
- [ ] Low cost (< $100)
- [ ] Moderate cost ($100-$1,000)
- [ ] High cost (> $1,000)
- [ ] Unknown

## What We Need

Please help us by providing:

- [ ] Link to state election office data source
- [ ] Data format and access method
- [ ] Any known costs or restrictions
- [ ] Help implementing data loader (optional)
- [ ] Contact information for state election office (if helpful)
